title: How I make $10,000 a month as a STUDENT (and how you can too) 💸
summary: A student creator warns off fast-money scams and course sellers, then recommends freelancing, print on demand, tutoring and selling notes over social media.

assertions.quote: it's already too late because everyone's doing it. So, your chances of success are slim to none.
they've earned most of their money by selling courses, not doing any of the jobs that the courses advertise
Freelancing is about selling a skill that you're good at on your own terms.

verdicts.note: Tutoring and freelance work pay real hourly rates, but platform competition is heavy and income stays tied to hours.

assertions.quote: Creating an account is free. You don't need any startup capital.
only one year on Etsy, almost 4,000 sales. That's $57,000 USD.
The reason why you think everyone does is because the [music] only people that post about it online are the ones who do.
It's a really long game and the money isn't even guaranteed.
